listing.name: SF-Ship-ED
listing.summary: The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers
listing.aiSummary: Edits ships, weapons, and variants with support for multipart vessels, damage modes, and raw file editing.

description:
The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers

Some of the bigger added features:

-Station/Multipart Vessel Mode
-Screenshot Mode
-Multi Mod de/activatior
-Linux installation Path support
-Damage Mode
-browse loaded mod files in most modes

aiDescription: Provides a comprehensive editor for Starsector ship data, including station and multipart vessel modes. Features include screenshot capabilities, multi-mod activation, projectile editing, and drag-and-drop functionality for variant files.
